notes: JMX3 uses worksheet B9 = 0.1935 in for workbook parity, not nominal #10 diameter 0.190 in.
Engagement develops the worksheet tensile area; it is not calculated by scaling the current axial load.

Mass uses consistent annular cap and insert volumes. Workbook E17 uses a different expression; E26 references B10 instead of density B6. Front insert formulas reference Old Summary Front. These are replaced with current tube dimensions and common geometry.
Circular plug approximation excludes hex flats, thread helix, chamfers, welds and machining tolerances.
